name: imitra
description: Root runner iMitra — satu perintah menghidupkan mock-slik, backend, dan frontend.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix mock-slik install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend exec -- prisma generate
scripts.build: npm --prefix mock-slik run build && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix mock-slik run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix mock-slik run test && npm --prefix backend run test:unit && npm --prefix frontend run test
